patch.value: Reproduce at the built CLI boundary, replace presence-only environment coercion with the shared strict boolean contract, retain the --read-only flag, cover true/false/invalid values and precedence, and verify the non-interactive setup path.
Explicit HASSIO_READONLY false enables read-only mode

Commander 15 treats the presence of the boolean option environment variable as enabled, so HASSIO_READONLY=false reaches getConfig as true and blocks service calls despite the loader supporting explicit false strings.

HASSIO_READONLY=false and equivalent false literals resolve false through the full program while true literals resolve true; Invalid values fail before network I/O with actionable guidance and the bare --read-only flag still enables protection
Full-program reproduction captured without private output and installed Commander Option behavior inspected
Make safety configuration deterministic in CI and agent shells.
Prevents false-negative execution availability and confusing setup failures.
CLI and loader share one validated boolean interpretation.
Live service-response verification failed solely because an explicit false environment value became true.
Commander 15 full hassio program with HASSIO_READONLY environment option
Run built hassio call-service with HASSIO_READONLY=false; observe read-only rejection before network execution.
The full program resolves readOnly true because Commander handles the option before the strict loader parser.
Automation and CI cannot explicitly disable a persisted read-only setting through the documented environment variable.

patch.value: Removed Commander env binding from the bare boolean option so the typed config loader exclusively parses explicit true and false values.
Strict loader parsing controls environment values and the command flag remains a one-way boolean enable switch.
Explicit false-like values leave execution enabled while true-like values and --read-only enable safety mode.
Fixed and covered at root-program and live-action levels.
Explicit false and 0 now disable read-only mode; true and the bare CLI flag still enable it. Unit and built live acceptance pass.
